scope: Feasibility of a NEW prospective convergent validation arm; never retroactive R2 PASS
fallback_candidate: Figshare:14905317, inventory and authoritative documentation only if primary not PASS
exposure: Previously read published descriptions: 16 natural-object patients, 30 multielement patients, different institutions. No candidate file inventory, neural values or outcomes previously inspected by this mission.

eligibility.training_spike_condition: NOT_VERIFIABLE_WITHOUT_SPIKES; future train-only QC, never infer from unit totals
eligibility.split: No replacement split created or data unlocked. Existing DANDI60/40 remains unchanged. Future validation arm requires separate prospective registration.
eligibility.anatomy: Explicit hippocampus only, hemisphere and simultaneous session identity required; other MTL never pooled
eligibility.patient: Patient is independent unit; aliases/repeated tasks grouped, no reidentification

allowed: Complete nested file inventory names/sizes/provider checksums/version dates
Separately identifiable plain-text README/license/data dictionary/export source or header/clock manifest, only after documented schema and access-plan lock
Raw header-only metadata if independently exposed as metadata; no signal-bearing file downloaded in this revision
forbidden: Model fitting, nulls, final validation or holdout changes
Downloaded code execution or author contact
uniform_rules: Inventory all discoverable public nodes/folders/files, retain access failures and unknown patients; never discard difficult cases. Published patient totals are potential only. Missing explicit unit/session/trial/native continuity/sync evidence is UNKNOWN, not zero eligibility or proof unusable.

source_policy.retries: At most 2 identical network retries, all attempt receipts retained; authoritative alternative DOI/provider/UI metadata paths permitted with receipt, never bypass permissions
source_policy.pagination: Follow public next/children links on allowlisted provider hosts; stop with INCONCLUSIVE if truncated/budget exhausted
source_policy.provider_hashes: Inventory provider checksum separately from locally SHA256-hashed metadata receipt. No claim full data bytes verified.

clock_oracle: Require independently documented raw acquisition start/end, timestamp units/reference, gap/block-validity metadata, event-neural clock map and synchronization description. Event endpoints alone, deidentified dates, spike extrema and common units are insufficient.

gate.PASS: Complete versioned licensed inventory, independent site/source cohort and canonical patient/session mapping, >=8 documented structurally eligible hippocampus-only patients with >=5 simultaneous units and >=40 valid trials, raw support/gaps/common clock evidence; future train-only activity QC explicitly pending
gate.FAIL: Authoritative positive evidence establishes incompatible population/license/support/independence or complete metadata establishes fewer than8 structurally eligible patients
gate.INCONCLUSIVE: Missing/inaccessible/unversioned/unmapped anatomy, identities, support/clock, or inadequate metadata to establish8; do not substitute published totals
gate.STOP: Always stop after this audit; no new cohort admission, fitting or final validation

outputs: file inventory and patient/session QC where available
